article.headline: The MLB CBA Expires in 32 Days. A Lockout Is Coming. Here's What It Means.

research.facts:
CBA / Lockout
**Source:** ESPN; SI.com; sportsnaut.com; morganlewis.com
**Confidence:** HIGH
